name: รับซ่อมแซม เสื้อผ้า

sources.ref: OSM node 13298710901's own name in both languages says the trade and not the tag: name=รับซ่อมแซม เสื้อผ้า ('clothing repairs accepted'), name:en=repair clothes. Its only shop tag is craft=tailor, which OSM uses for the whole needle trade and which this shelf had been reading as bespoke. Read in cache/overpass/cm/crafts.json, crawled 2026-07-27. cat is untouched: this is still shopping.
